name: Bgf Co. Ltd.
summary: BGF Co., Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of investment services. It operates through the following business divisions: Invest, Materials/Chemistry, Electronic/Automotive Parts Materials, Semiconductor Materials, and Advertising/Delivery/E-commerce. The Invest business division is involved in the investment business. The Materials/Chemistry business division consists of polymer chip manufacturing and sale, sorting and recycling of raw materials, and manufacturing of plastic materials and products. The Electronic/Automotive Parts Materials business division manufactures electronics and automotive interior materials. The Semiconductor Materials business division offers industrial gas manufacturing. The Advertising/Deliver/E-commerce business division provides advertising, delivery, and e-commerce services. The company was founded on December 1, 1994 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
